STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_064231.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_064231.v · Open raw
module origen_064231(
    input wire clk,
    input wire run_code,
    input wire in_flag,
    input wire out_flag,
    input wire [7:0] in,
    input wire [11:0] address,
    input wire [15:0] code,
    output reg [11:0] pc,
    output reg [15:0] ac,
    output reg fgo,
    output reg fgi,
    output reg [7:0] out,
    output wire [15:0] test
);

    reg [15:0] ir, dr;
    reg e;
    reg [15:0] mem [0:4095];
    reg if_hlt;

    wire [2:0] opcode = ir[14:12];
    wire i = ir[15];
    wire [11:0] operand = ir[11:0];

    assign test = ac;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!run_code) begin
            mem[address] <= code;
        end else if (!if_hlt) begin
            // Fetch
            ir <= mem[pc];
            pc <= pc + 1;

            // Execute
            case (opcode)
                3'b000: ac <= ac & mem[operand];  // AND
                3'b001: {e, ac} <= ac + mem[operand] + e;  // ADD
                3'b010: ac <= mem[operand];  // LOAD
                3'b011: mem[operand] <= ac;  // STORE
                3'b100: pc <= operand;  // JUMP
                3'b101: begin  // CALL
                    mem[operand] <= pc;
                    pc <= operand + 1;
                end
                3'b110: begin  // ISZ
                    dr <= mem[operand] + 1;
                    mem[operand] <= dr;
                    if (dr == 0) pc <= pc + 1;
                end
                3'b111: begin  // Register reference and I/O
                    case (ir[11:0])
                        12'h800: ac <= 0;  // CLA
                        12'h400: e <= 0;  // CLE
                        12'h200: ac <= ~ac;  // CMA
                        12'h100: e <= ~e;  // CME
                        12'h080: {ac, e} <= {e, ac};  // CIR
                        12'h040: {e, ac} <= {ac, e};  // CIL
                        12'h020: ac <= ac + 1;  // INC
                        12'h010: if (ac[15] == 0) pc <= pc + 1;  // SPA
                        12'h008: if (ac[15] == 1) pc <= pc + 1;  // SNA
                        12'h004: if (ac == 0) pc <= pc + 1;  // SZA
                        12'h002: if (e == 0) pc <= pc + 1;  // SZE
                        12'h001: if_hlt <= 1;  // HLT
                        12'hF800: begin  // INP
                            if (in_flag) begin
                                ac[7:0] <= in;
                                fgi <= 0;
                            end
                        end
                        12'hF400: begin  // OUT
                            if (out_flag) begin
                                out <= ac[7:0];
                                fgo <= 0;
                            end
                        end
                        12'hF200: if (fgi == 1) pc <= pc + 1;  // SKI
                        12'hF100: if (fgo == 0) pc <= pc + 1;  // SKO
                    endcase
                end
            endcase

            // Indirect addressing
            if (i) begin
                case (opcode)
                    3'b000, 3'b001, 3'b010, 3'b011: begin
                        dr <= mem[operand];
                        mem[operand] <= mem[dr];
                    end
                    3'b100, 3'b101: pc <= mem[operand];
                    3'b110: begin
                        dr <= mem[operand];
                        mem[operand] <= mem[dr] + 1;
                        if (mem[dr] + 1 == 0) pc <= pc + 1;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (in_flag) fgi <= 1;
        if (out_flag) fgo <= 1;
    end

endmodule
